name: Final Warning

frame.name: All at Once
frame.description: Holding down the trigger marks targets within range and loads multiple bullets, which fire in a burst with increased stability on trigger release. Hitting a marked target with a fully charged burst will unravel them.

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.description:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Pick Your Poison
perks.description:
Hipfiring: Projectiles will track marked targets, dealing increased body shot damage on impact.

Aiming: Projectiles have greatly increased velocity and cause extra damage when dealing precision final blows to marked targets.

perks.name: Combat Grip
perks.description:
This weapon's recoil direction is more vertical.
  •  Greatly controls recoil

flavor: The flit of tiny wings; the pull of a trigger.

catalyst.name: Final Warning Catalyst
catalyst.description: Hits against marked targets deal increased damage and have a chance to refund ammo to the magazine.
